No more embarrassing late joins, missing client calls, or that panicked "I completely forgot about our meeting" feeling. Stay in deep focus knowing that when it truly matters, Focusmo will pull you back at exactly the right moment.

## Personalize your alerts exactly how you want them [...] ## Smart calendar connection with powerful filtering

Focusmo seamlessly connects with your calendar and automatically detects all your meetings and events. You're in complete control of which events trigger alerts through powerful filtering options based on keywords, participants, calendar source, and more.

Only want alerts for client meetings? Filter by the word "client" in the title. Need to prioritize meetings with your boss? Create a filter for their name in the attendee list. This intelligent filtering system ensures you only get interrupted for what truly matters to you.
